anya: quick flag  perf saw a memory regression in stage. need a crisp MVP decision: cut small features or delay 2 weeks.

tom: which features are candidates?

anya: shortlist: tenant SSO, analytics-export, admin heatmap. Keep embcache and core knobs.

priya: infra note  memory leak in cache worker under high-concurrency map jobs. fix+QA ~8 business days. we can ship with a hotfix toggle + throttles.

jose: ops mitigation: per-tenant RPS cap 150, embcache protective mode (read-only warm paths) behind flag, canary ramp 2% -> 20% with automated SLO checks.

lina: sales: two pilots need SSO. if we drop SSO from MVP offer a manual paid pilot with SAML assist. keeps deals alive.

anya: decision proposal: trim tenant SSO from MVP, keep analytics-export for now, enable embcache protective mode, enforce throttles & canary guards, and offer manual SSO pilot. Anyone blocking?

tom: +1 from eng. I'll gate SSO behind a feature flag and add onboarding notes.

priya: +1. I'll push the hotfix toggle and a staging smoke with leak monitor.

jose: +1. I'll write canary automation and quarantine flow. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% after 30m if p95 < 900ms and errors < 0.4%.

lina: +1. I'll draft pilot comms and a customer FAQ.

deploy-bot: Release window unchanged. Canary ticket #8234 attached to release notes.

anya: action items:
- priya: hotfix toggle + staging leak smoke  due Thu EOD
- jose: canary automation + quarantine runbook  due Tue noon
- tom: feature flag + onboarding doc for SSO pilot  due Wed
- lina: pilot comms & faq  due Wed noon

anya: reconvene Thu 9am dry-run. if staging leak repro >5% we re-evaluate delay. :thumbsup:
